answer: Give each agent a single thread of verifiable work that grows only by finishing real tasks, one at a time, with each step signed by the client who received it. To forge a trusted identity an attacker must pay the same slow labour for every fake, because identities cannot be copied or bought in bulk. Add decay like a comet fading: idle reputation shrinks, so hoarded Sybils rot before they can vote. Fake identities then cost real time and real work, which is exactly what an attacker cannot mass-produce.
